Package io.github.janglada.orkit.booking

Class AppointmentConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.booking.AppointmentConfig
public final class AppointmentConfig extends Object
Fluent configurator for a single appointment. Used inside the lambda passed to BookingBuilder.appointment(String, java.util.function.Consumer).

An appointment must declare a duration and a non-empty set of candidate resources; an optional earliest / latest window and an unscheduled penalty may be set.

  • Method Details

    • duration

      public AppointmentConfig duration(Duration d)
      Sets how long the appointment occupies its chosen resource. Must be at least one minute.

    • requiresAnyOf

      public AppointmentConfig requiresAnyOf(String... ids)
      Declares the candidate resources for the appointment's main requirement: it is booked on exactly one of them when scheduled. Replaces any earlier call; use alsoRequiresAnyOf(String...) or requiresAllOf(String...) to add further requirements.

    • alsoRequiresAnyOf

      public AppointmentConfig alsoRequiresAnyOf(String... ids)
      Adds a further requirement: one of ids is booked at the same time as the main resource, for example a room alongside a doctor. Repeatable.

    • requiresAllOf

      public AppointmentConfig requiresAllOf(String... ids)
      Requires every one of ids at the same time, each as its own requirement (for example a surgeon, an anesthetist and an operating room). Repeatable.

    • earliest

      public AppointmentConfig earliest(LocalDateTime dt)
      Earliest wall-clock time at which the appointment may start.

    • latest

      public AppointmentConfig latest(LocalDateTime dt)
      Latest wall-clock time by which the appointment must end.

    • buffer

      public AppointmentConfig buffer(Duration d)
      Turnaround time the resource stays blocked after the appointment (cleanup, travel). It is not part of the reported AppointmentAssignment.end() and may spill past the resource's availability window or the appointment's latest(LocalDateTime), but never overlaps another appointment on the same resource. Default zero.

    • penaltyIfUnscheduled

      public AppointmentConfig penaltyIfUnscheduled(long p)
      Penalty incurred if this appointment cannot be scheduled. Defaults to 1.
